name: Soil potash, K2O-equivalent plant-available potassium
source: Reported as K2O equivalent, the standard agronomic convention for the 'K' figure in an N-P2O5-K2O fertiliser analysis. K2O formula mass 94.195 from IUPAC standard atomic weights (K 39.098 x2, O 15.999). K fraction 78.196/94.195 = 83.0150%.
notes: K is rounded to the nearest microgram; O closes exactly. As with soil-phosphate, the oxide convention is a reporting unit inherited from fertiliser labelling, not a claim about the mineral form potassium actually takes in soil.
